subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below.
stimulus: Health is the root of all pleasures It cannot enjoy his life A person should be aware of taking proper and nutritive food But a person having ill health wealth He happy when he is blessed with sound health
guide_solution: Producing sentences from a substitution table: (i) Health is wealth. (ii) It is the root of all pleasures. (iii) A person is happy when he is blessed with sound health. (iv) But a person having ill health, cannot enjoy his life. (v) He should be aware of taking proper and nutritive food.
